subject: POC alignment — acceptance metrics, infra custodianship & procurement window
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Ava Cloud <ava@clearviewtech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC alignment — acceptance metrics, infra custodianship & procurement window

Ava — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC dates: 

Summary of what we heard
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for batch-and-real-time generation across two Clearview workloads (SearchAssist and Ingest-cleaning).
- Key success metrics: 95th pct latency < 200ms for SearchAssist baseline, 30% token-cost reduction vs current setup on sustained workload, and <1% quality regression on the evaluation holdout.

Proposed plan (high level)
1) Prework (week of Jul 5): security questionnaire returned, procurement window confirmed, temporary service account + VPC peering details.
2) POC run (Jul 12 — Aug 9): 4-week trial with weekly checkpoints. Week 1: infra + traffic shaping; Week 2: model tweaks and quantization test; Week 3: load & regression; Week 4: acceptance + handover.
3) Acceptance: meet the three metrics above on the evaluation dataset and agree on go/no-go in final call.

Immediate asks from Clearview (action items)
- Please confirm your infra owner (who will coordinate network/VPC work) and procurement contact (timeline for legal/SOW).
- Return the attached security questionnaire by Jun 25 so our infra team can pre-clear the environment.
- Any blackout dates between Jul 12—Aug 9 we should avoid for cutover.

Attachments: redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx, security_questionnaire.pdf

I’ll draft a simple RACI and a one-page runbook once we get the owners confirmed. If that timeline works, I’ll schedule the kickoff for Jul 6 (prework sync) and Jul 12 as POC day-1.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC alignment — acceptance metrics, infra custodianship & procurement window

Thanks Nikhil — appreciate the clear summary. Confirming ownership and a slight tweak to the timeline:

Ownership at Clearview
- Infra/Network lead: Jasper Li (jasper@clearviewtech.com) — will handle VPC peering and firewall rules.
- Procurement / Contracts: Elaine Park (elaine@clearviewtech.com) — timeline below.
- Product lead for evaluation (metrics sign-off): Mariah Torres (mariah.t@clearviewtech.com).

Timeline notes
- Elaine indicates legal needs ~10 business days for an MOU/SOW once we have the commercial terms. Procurement suggests we aim for signature by Jul 9 to keep Jul 12 POC start feasible. Elaine attached a quick procurement timeline.
- Security questionnaire: Jasper asked for 48 hours to review internally once we share answers.

Blackout dates: We have a global release window Jul 20—22 (avoid heavy load tests then).

Next steps from our side
- I’ll introduce Jasper and Elaine on a short thread so they have the doc links.
- Elaine: procurement timeline attached (clearview_poc_timeline.xlsx).

Looking forward — this plan looks workable.

Best,
Ava Cloud
Head of Integrations, Clearview Tech
ava@clearviewtech.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>

Copying the team so we can assign owners on the Redwood side and confirm internal runbook items. Proposed Redwood RACI (ask: please confirm assignments):

- Infra / Cloud setup (VPC peering, subnets, monitoring): Karthik Iyer — owner, will coordinate with Jasper for firewall rules and peering.
- App integration (ingest hooks, auth, SDK integration): Monica Patel — owner, will own test harness and regression suite.
- Security & compliance (questionnaire, logs, controls): Priya Natarajan — owner, will run the security Q and provide evidence (SOC pointers).
- Commercial contact / kickoff coordination: Nikhil Sharma — owner for scheduling, SOW follow-through, and weekly checkpoints.

Key internal deliverables before Jul 5 prework sync
- Karthik: draft VPC peering steps and traffic-shaping doc.
- Monica: baseline test harness + the evaluation dataset subset (share link).
- Priya: complete security_questionnaire.pdf answers and list of audit artifacts.
- Nikhil: send one-page runbook + draft RACI to Clearview; confirm DocuSign link for MOU.

Notes: avoid heavy load tests during Jul 20—22 (Clearview release window). Also, Elaine requested a one-page SOW summary to speed procurement — I’ll pull that together.

I’ve attached a working runbook (poc_runbook_v1.md) and the checklist — these are early drafts. Please reply with confirmations and any blockers by EOD Thu Jun 24 so I can lock the kickoff calendar.

Thanks all,
Nikhil
